title: 浮光萤尘 / Firefly garden
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party graph; MIT TiXL/GLM/Godot renderer and particle dependencies; outbound license pending

descriptions.zh-CN: 暖金细尘与青绿萤光分层漂浮，轻微流场和短拖尾营造景深。可调密度、流速、拖尾和配色。
descriptions.en-US: Layered gold dust and soft jade fireflies drift through a gentle field. Adjust density, flow, trails and palette.
